sequence: One visible Atlas Globe placed and saved on an 8x8 map; Undo available after Save
Top margin +1 accepted with OK; map becomes 8x9; Undo and Redo become disabled
Ctrl+Z and Undo click leave the 8x9 map and earlier object intact
Ctrl+Y and Redo click leave the saved map byte-identical
A fresh process opens the same 8x9 map with the object
gap: Whether new actions after resize can be undone, and whether older history is deleted internally or only blocked, was not tested.
